blocks.title: Diffraction
blocks.text: Diffraction roshni ka rukawaton ke gird murna aur roshni ki lehron ka rukawat ke geometrical saye mein phailna hai.

Agar interference tajurbe mein slits ki tadaad barhayi jaye aur pados ke slits ka faasla wahi rahe to maxima apni jagah par rehte lekin do slits ke muqable lagatar tang hote jate hain. Kyunke yeh maxima itne tang hain, un ki angular jagahein, aur yun wavelength, bohat durusti se napi ja sakti hain.

blocks.title: Diffraction grating
blocks.text: Diffraction grating bohat si mutawazi slits ki tarteeb hai, sab aik chaurai ki aur markazon ke darmiyan barabar faasle d par. Faasla d grating spacing kehlata hai; slits ko aksar rulings ya lines kehte hain.

Pehli grating Fraunhofer ne bareek taron se banayi. Gratings diamond ki nok se sheeshe ya dhaat par barabar faasle ki bohat si lakeerein khurach kar, ya siyah aur safed dhaariyon ke naqshe ko photographic tareeqe se chhota kar ke banayi ja sakti hain. Fig 15.16 transmission grating ka section hai; khaaka sirf paanch slits dikhata hai, lekin asal grating mein kai hazar ho sakti hain. Aik rang ki plane lehar grating par amudan parti hai. Door-field (Fraunhofer) halaat farz kiye jate hain: screen itni door hai ke grating se screen ke aik nuqte ki taraf jane wali tamam shuaein mutawazi samjhi ja sakti hain.

blocks.alt: Khari grating jis mein d faasle par paanch slits hain. Baen se mutawazi gulabi shuaein aati hain; har slit se shua seedhi (dashed) simt se theta zawiye par neeche nikalti hai. Har slit par shua ka chhota mota hissa, jo neeche wali slit se nuqta-daar amood kaat-ta hai, delta L hai; oopar delta L = d sin theta likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.16: Diffraction grating (kitab ki Figure 15.16 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Bare maxima un simton mein hote hain jin ke liye pados ke slits ka rasta farq wavelengths ka poora adad ho: d sin(theta) = n lambda, jahan n = 0, +/-1, +/-2, +/-3, ... (15.7). Jab saikron ya hazaron slits wali grating par aik rang ki mutawazi roshni pare to naqsha bohat tez lakeeron ka silsila hota hai (Fig 15.17). n = +/-1 lakeerein first-order, n = +/-2 second-order, aur markazi maximum (n = 0) zero order hai. Safed roshni mein har order mukammal spectrum hota hai; kisi n ke liye lambi wavelengths (surkh) chhoti wavelengths (neeli) se zyada zawiye par murti hain.

blocks.alt: Laser diffraction grating se p faasle par screen par roshni dalta hai. Paanch gulabi lakeerein screen tak phailti hain, oopar se neeche n = 2, 1, 0, 1, 2; pehle aur doosre order ke zawiye theta1 aur theta2 dikhaye gaye hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.17: Naqshe ke orders (kitab ki Figure 15.17 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki Fig 15.17 mein orders 'a = 2, a = 1, a = 0' chhape hain aur dono zawiyon par theta1 hai. Durust nishan n hai (d sin theta = n lambda), aur doosre order ka zawiya theta2 hai, jo theta1 se bara hai. Khaake mein yahi likha hai.

Murne ke zawiyon ke sine lambda / d ke mutanasib hain, is liye numayan murne ke liye grating spacing d wavelength ke darje ka hona chahiye. Nazar aane wali roshni (lambda 400 se 700 nm) ki gratings mein aam taur par taqreeban 1000 slits fi millimetre hoti hain; d fi ikai lambai slits ki tadaad ka ulat hai, is liye d taqreeban 1000 nm hai.

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat
blocks.text: Kitab 100 slits aur 2000 slits wali gratings se safed roshni ke spectrum ki tasaveer dikhati hai; zyada slits ke saath spectrum zyada phailta aur rang zyada tez hote hain. Yeh aik 'dilchasp istemal' bhi dikhati hai, pahari ke gird radio lehron ka diffraction, jis se radio signals paharon ke peeche ki jagahon tak pohanchte hain.

Aik grating mein 500 lakeerein fi millimetre hain. 600 nm wavelength ki roshni us par amudan parti hai. First-order maximum ka zawiya maloom karein. Hal: d = 1 mm / 500 = 2.0 x 10^-6 m. sin(theta) = n lambda / d = (1)(600 x 10^-9) / (2.0 x 10^-6) = 0.30, is liye theta = 17.5 darje. Mumkina sab se oonchi order woh sab se bara n hai jis ke liye n lambda / d, 1 se kam ho: n = 3 (sin(theta) = 0.90).

blocks.prompt: Diffraction grating ke liye zyada slits aur qareeb qareeb slits ke kya faide hain?
blocks.explanation: Zyada slits maxima ko kaheen tez aur roshan banati hain, is liye wavelengths durusti se napi aur qareebi wavelengths alag ki ja sakti hain. Qareeb slits (chhota d) orders ko bare zawiyon tak phailati hain, jis se zyada phailao (dispersion) milta hai.

blocks.prompt: Kisi grating mein surkh roshni ki jagah neeli roshni dalne se naqsha kaise badlega?
blocks.explanation: Neeli roshni ki wavelength chhoti hai, is liye har order ke liye sin(theta) = n lambda / d kam hai: lakeerein markazi maximum ke qareeb aa jati hain, aur zyada orders mumkin hote hain.

items: Grating: barabar faasle ki bohat si slits; d sin(theta) = n lambda.
Orders n = 0, +/-1, +/-2; surkh neeli se zyada murti; nazar aane wali roshni ke liye d taqreeban 1000 nm.
